independence: Recorded before receiving any lead verdict. Review is independent advice from the brief author, not a blind test.

review.function: A parked freight cart, broad loading floor, roofed judging platform, banked lane and conspicuous red transverse strip clearly establish downhill transport and braking practice.
review.route: The main descending lane curves continuously toward the red strip; a separate flat pedestrian/loading apron is protected by a low dividing wall.
review.cohesion: Black/white/red infrastructure and forceful perspective fit the action-world identity. Dense realistic surface texture and skyline detail may compete with the later manga character designs.
concerns: The cart appears to have more than the requested two wheels; minor incidental equipment topology drift, not the central card.
Beyond the red strip the lane continues out of frame; the strip is readable but a safe final stopping pocket and arrest distance are not established.
Additional red edge stripes dilute the exclusive meaning of the stopping strip, although that strip remains largest.
review.severity: strong visible logistics and route cues; safety performance not demonstrated
review.later_matching_check: Brake wedge should fit the cart wheel diameter and contact the ground convincingly; route paddle and spring ram should share the infrastructure’s restrained red usage.

review.function: An enormous bronze pipe visibly enters a stepped public bath and emits localized steam. Vault, door and raised surrounding ledge establish a plausible warming hall.
review.route: A continuous dry-looking stone ledge circles the bath and reaches the rear door. Pipe consumes substantial ledge width at right but does not visibly sever the route.
review.cohesion: Curved dense engraved hatching, parchment and bronze are strong, consistent material cues. The monumental pipe offers a clear visual identity without a gear maze.
concerns: The specified empty bath is visibly filled; that improves immediate heat-function communication but changes its authored state.
A small right-side valve has a round handwheel rather than a visible square stem; the planned square-jaw pipe key cannot be claimed to operate this depicted valve.
Near-uniform dense hatching and brown value compress the room at small scale; actual gallery inspection is needed before judging readability.
review.severity: coherent heating scene; future tool-to-valve mismatch risk
review.later_matching_check: G1 pipe key needs a demonstrable square receiving stem elsewhere or a clear external limitation; do not infer compatibility from shared bronze. Quiet collar must be sized to a smaller accessible pipe, not this enormous elbow.

review.function: Large stair, arch doorway, bench and mint mechanical socket clearly support a civic access setting; the socket supplies a non-generic world cue.
review.route: All major stair treads and the raised doorway are visible. There is ample bypass space on either side of the front socket.
review.cohesion: Terracotta/mint/cream and clear contour form a consistent family; subtle modeled shadows and stone texture exceed strict flatness but preserve readable masses.
concerns: The large mint socket is a loose-looking raised plate sitting on top of the front tread, not a flush socket within the step. It reads as an obstacle or trip hazard.
No visible load-bearing connection links the plate’s internal bolts to a stair-lifting mechanism; adjustment function remains speculative.
More than the brief’s five steps and extra background arches were generated; route remains intelligible despite this drift.
review.severity: clear architecture with a significant visible mechanism-integration concern
review.later_matching_check: Step jack must plausibly mate to this actual socket instead of merely sharing mint paint. Bridge plank hooks require matching receiving edges; the level frame should not be treated as proof that the existing stair is adjustable.

review.function: Outdoor cooking stove, fruit tree, broad rain bowl, windbreak wall and shelter entrance establish a weather-conscious orchard kitchen.
review.route: Wide orange path leads cleanly between stove and tree to the open shelter; fixed objects do not block it.
review.cohesion: Turquoise/orange/green and large rounded architecture support the intended family, but the image is highly painted and textured with numerous small leaves and utensils, not a strongly simplified bold cartoon background.
concerns: The empty rain bowl and storm cloud suggest weather collection but do not establish forecasting or cloud-bison ecology by themselves.
Black chimney smoke and distant rain darken the everyday image; E2 should distinguish an immediate mechanical hazard rather than simply add more storm.
Multiple pots, hanging pans, shelves and planters exceed the planned three principal masses and minimal inventory.
review.severity: usable spatial and culinary cues with style/density drift
review.later_matching_check: Wind ladle and foldable screen should match thick functional hinges and bowl forms. A new bison must stay anatomically separate from painted clouds. Mill brake must later relate to a visible rotor rim.

review.function: A bound reed bundle, shears, hanging black cloth and red soaking vat plausibly communicate textile/dye work. The central aisle and bright rear doorway are unmistakable.
review.route: Clear straight route between the counter and vat; cloth spills over the vat’s near outside edge but does not cross the central aisle.
review.cohesion: Black/bone/crimson materials cohere; the finish reads very photographic/realistic interior rather than visibly thin-contour fashion illustration.
concerns: A dense second forest of black reeds rises behind the vat in addition to the single bound bundle; this adds major botanical noise beyond the intended restraint.
Wet dark-red liquid, streaks and tangled soaked cloth can read as blood or viscera at a glance even though no actual gore is depicted; everyday dye-work function depends on context.
An extra pair of silver shears is visible on the counter before the G1 card is generated, creating an additional shape that future equipment may fail to match.
Seasonal dormancy and forced-harvest labor stakes are not visually established by the room alone.
review.severity: legible dye workspace with tonal ambiguity and future prop-reference risk
review.later_matching_check: Compare generated reed shears with the already depicted counter shears; preserve distinction between red dye and injury. Creature must use exactly four clear roots rather than inheriting the background’s many fine stems.
